# Termux-Playwright Full Technical Specification (v1.2.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Non-Root Chromium Browser Automation & CDP Engine for Android Termux
Controls genuine Chromium processes via direct Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) WebSocket sessions on Android Bionic libc without root or graphical servers.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-playwright
- Command: pip install termux-playwright
# or: npm install termux-playwright
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-playwright-demo

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Direct CDP Control Channel**: Connects directly via Chrome DevTools Protocol without heavy WebDriver server binaries.
- **Non-Root Mobile Execution**: Fully operational inside standard Termux without root privileges or custom ROMs.
- **Full Python & JavaScript APIs**: Offers familiar Playwright-compatible async page navigation, selectors, and evaluation.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
from termux_playwright import chromium

async def main():
    browser = await chromium.launch(headless=True)
    page = await browser.new_page()
    await page.goto("https://uno-km.github.io/uno-km/")
    title = await page.title()
    print(f"Page Title: {title}")
    await browser.close()

import asyncio
asyncio.run(main())

```
